[MINECRAFT] User: how do i branch mine efficiently in minecraft
Assistant: To branch mine efficiently, follow this order: 1) choose a productive depth. 2) make a main hallway with side branches. 3) keep branch spacing efficient. 4) light and mark your route clearly. 5) return to smelt and sort instead of hoarding everything on one trip. Structured branch mining is boring but very reliable for steady ore income. If you tunnel with poor spacing, you waste time rechecking the same blocks.

[MINECRAFT] User: how do i learn redstone basics in minecraft
Assistant: To learn redstone basics, follow this order: 1) learn how power travels through dust. 2) practice with levers, buttons, pistons, and repeaters. 3) build one small mechanism at a time. 4) test each section before combining them. 5) label or separate parts if the circuit gets messy. Redstone gets easier once you stop trying to build everything as one giant first attempt. Debugging is much harder when you skip small tests and wire the whole build at once.

[MINECRAFT] User: how do i ask solasai something in minecraft
Assistant: Use /solasai ask <prompt> or /askai <prompt>. The mod sends your prompt to the backend and posts the reply back into chat.

[MINECRAFT] User: how do i change the solasai backend
Assistant: Use /solasai backend <url>. The client stores the endpoint and sends future chat and mc-agent requests there.

[CHAT] User: how do i check the solasai backend url
Assistant: Use /solasai backend with no extra argument. It prints the current configured backend endpoint.

[CHAT] User: how do i see the current ai task
Assistant: Use /solasai task or /solasai tas. The client shows the current task text from the controller.

[MINECRAFT] User: how do i check the stronghold estimate
Assistant: Use /solasai stronghold. If the mod has triangulated enough eye throws, it will print the estimated stronghold coordinates.

[CHAT] User: can solasai read chat
Assistant: Yes. The Fabric client registers a chat receive event and can react to incoming chat lines when auto-reply is enabled.

[CHAT] User: can solasai send chat messages
Assistant: Yes. The client can send normal chat through the player network handler and can also issue slash commands when needed.

[CODE] User: how do i toggle the ai overlay
Assistant: Press F3 plus Tab. The mod toggles the debug overlay and prints whether the overlay is now on or off.

[CHAT] User: how do i start ai control
Assistant: Press Ctrl plus Tab while in game with no screen open. That opens the SolasAI prompt screen so you can start the controller with an objective.

[CHAT] User: how do i stop ai control
Assistant: Press Escape or Escape plus Tab while the AI is active. The controller stops and releases movement inputs.

[CHAT] User: what does ai join do
Assistant: AI Join connects to a multiplayer server with an objective and starts the controller once the world loads.

[CHAT] User: what does solasai bases do
Assistant: The /solasai bases command asks the bot service for saved base candidates on the current server and prints them in chat.

[CHAT] User: can the mod run swarms
Assistant: Yes. The client can send a swarm start request to the bot service with count, username mode, jobs, and auto-think settings.

[CHAT] User: does solasai use chat history
Assistant: For chat replies, the backend keeps short session context so responses can stay consistent across recent messages.

[MINECRAFT] User: can solasai read minecraft state
Assistant: Yes. The mc-agent endpoint receives a game state snapshot including health, food, enemies, and other context for decision making.

[CHAT] User: how do i make chat replies trigger
Assistant: Mention solasai in chat when auto-reply is enabled or use the ask commands directly if you want a forced backend reply.

[CHAT] User: can solasai send slash commands
Assistant: Yes. The controller already uses sendChatCommand when possible and falls back to a slash-prefixed chat message if needed.

[MINECRAFT] User: explain minecraft redstone timing
Assistant: Redstone updates run in game ticks at 20 ticks per second. One redstone tick is 2 game ticks. Repeaters add delay in redstone ticks, and many circuits are stable only when you plan around that timing.

[MINECRAFT] User: how fast is minecraft tick speed
Assistant: The normal server speed is 20 game ticks per second, so each tick is 0.05 seconds. If TPS drops, all redstone, mob AI, and physics feel slower.

[MINECRAFT] User: what is a redstone tick
Assistant: A redstone tick is 2 game ticks, which is 0.1 seconds at full TPS. Repeater delay settings are measured in redstone ticks.

[MINECRAFT] User: why does my redstone machine desync
Assistant: Most desync comes from mixed delays, observer pulse timing, or chunk borders. Keep signal paths symmetrical, add repeaters where needed, and test the machine fully loaded.

[MINECRAFT] User: why does my machine break at chunk borders
Assistant: Redstone and entities outside loaded chunks stop updating. Keep critical logic inside loaded chunks or use chunk loading strategies designed for your version.

[MINECRAFT] User: what is quasi connectivity
Assistant: Quasi connectivity is a Java Edition behavior where some blocks like pistons and dispensers can be powered indirectly from above in specific update states. Many compact contraptions rely on this quirk.

[MINECRAFT] User: how many blocks can a slime block push
Assistant: A piston can push up to 12 movable blocks total in one push. Slime and honey machines must stay within that push limit or they fail.

[MINECRAFT] User: can slime and honey stick together
Assistant: Slime blocks and honey blocks do not stick to each other, which is useful for multi-direction flying machines and compact split mechanisms.

[MINECRAFT] User: how do observers work in redstone
Assistant: Observers detect block state changes in front and output a short pulse from the back. They are great for pulse generation, edge detection, and compact timing.

[MINECRAFT] User: why is my observer clock unstable
Assistant: Observer clocks can overfire if updates loop through adjacent blocks unpredictably. Isolate the clock, control pulse length, and avoid accidental feedback paths.

[MINECRAFT] User: what affects tnt explosions in minecraft
Assistant: Explosion damage depends on blast resistance of blocks, distance from the blast center, and line-of-sight through resistant blocks. Water can also greatly reduce explosion effects.

[MINECRAFT] User: why does tnt not break some blocks
Assistant: Some blocks have high blast resistance or special immunity. Obsidian and certain technical blocks resist normal TNT blasts.

[MINECRAFT] User: how long is tnt fuse in minecraft
Assistant: Standard TNT fuse is 80 game ticks, about 4 seconds at 20 TPS. Timing chains should account for TPS drops on busy servers.

[MINECRAFT] User: what is entity cramming
Assistant: Entity cramming is damage applied when too many entities occupy the same space. It is often used in farm kill chambers and can affect mob handling physics.

[MINECRAFT] User: how does mob spawning really work
Assistant: Hostile mobs need valid spawn blocks, light conditions, and player-distance rules. Spawn-proofing caves and nearby areas usually increases farm rates more than just enlarging the farm.

[MINECRAFT] User: what is random tick speed in minecraft
Assistant: Random tick speed controls random block updates such as crop growth and leaf decay. It is separate from TPS and should be changed carefully in survival worlds.

[MINECRAFT] User: why do pistons spit out blocks sometimes
Assistant: Block spitting depends on short pulse timing around piston extension and retraction. If pulse timing is inconsistent due to lag or update order, the behavior becomes unreliable.

[MINECRAFT] User: explain computer file systems simply

[CHAT] User: what is the difference between hdd and ssd
Assistant: HDDs use spinning disks and are slower but cheaper per gigabyte. SSDs use flash memory, have much faster random access, and usually make boot and app loading far quicker.

[MINECRAFT] User: what does a cpu do
Assistant: The CPU executes instructions, handles logic and arithmetic, and coordinates program flow. Good CPU performance depends on architecture, clock speed, cache, and core/thread count.

[MINECRAFT] User: what does a gpu do
Assistant: A GPU accelerates massively parallel work like graphics rendering, video processing, and many AI workloads. It is optimized for running large numbers of similar operations at once.

[MINECRAFT] User: what is ram used for
Assistant: RAM is short-term working memory for active programs and data. More RAM helps multitasking and reduces slow disk swapping when many apps are open.

[CHAT] User: why is nvme faster than sata
Assistant: NVMe uses PCIe lanes with lower overhead and much higher bandwidth than SATA. That gives far better throughput and latency, especially for parallel I/O.

[MINECRAFT] User: what is a cpu cache
Assistant: CPU cache is very fast memory on or near the processor that stores frequently used data and instructions. L1 is fastest and smallest, then L2 and L3 are larger but slower.

[CHAT] User: explain binary encoding
Assistant: Binary encoding represents information using bits, 0 and 1. Text encodings like UTF-8 map characters to byte sequences, while formats like PNG or MP4 encode structured binary data with specific rules.

[CHAT] User: what is an encoder and decoder
Assistant: An encoder converts data into another format for storage or transmission, and a decoder reverses that process. Example: video encoders compress frames, and decoders reconstruct playable video.

[CHAT] User: how do monitors display images
Assistant: The GPU sends pixel data to the display, and the monitor refreshes the panel many times per second. Resolution sets pixel count, refresh rate sets update frequency, and response time affects motion clarity.

[CHAT] User: what is refresh rate
Assistant: Refresh rate is how many times per second a display updates, measured in hertz. Higher rates like 120Hz or 144Hz usually make motion feel smoother than 60Hz.

[MINECRAFT] User: what is latency in computers
Assistant: Latency is delay between request and response. Lower latency improves responsiveness in storage access, networking, input handling, and rendering pipelines.

[CHAT] User: what is throughput vs latency
Assistant: Throughput is how much work or data is processed per second, while latency is how long one operation takes. A system can have high throughput but still feel slow if latency is high.

[MINECRAFT] User: what is a compiler
Assistant: A compiler translates source code into machine code or another target form before execution. This often enables strong optimization and faster runtime compared to pure interpretation.

[CHAT] User: what is an interpreter
Assistant: An interpreter executes code step-by-step at runtime instead of producing a standalone binary first. It is often flexible for scripting and rapid iteration.

[CHAT] User: what is virtual memory
Assistant: Virtual memory lets the OS give each process an isolated address space and move inactive pages to disk when RAM is limited. It improves safety and multitasking but swapping is much slower than RAM.

[CHAT] User: how does file compression work
Assistant: Compression removes redundancy so data uses fewer bytes. Lossless methods preserve exact data, while lossy methods trade some quality for much smaller size.

[CHAT] User: what is a codec
Assistant: A codec is a coder-decoder pair for specific media formats, such as H.264 or Opus. Different codecs balance quality, bitrate, decode speed, and compatibility.

[MINECRAFT] User: what is endianness
Assistant: Endianness is the byte order used to store multi-byte numbers. Big-endian stores the most significant byte first, while little-endian stores the least significant byte first.

[CHAT] User: how does the os use file permissions
Assistant: File permissions control which users or processes can read, write, or execute files. They help enforce security boundaries and reduce accidental or malicious modification.
